title: Billy S NDE 5069/5067 NDE 5067
content:
5069 I was practicing a choke hold on another Marine and then he held my neck and that was when I felt my spirit rise above my body. I looked up and saw a dark tunnel with the same bright light I saw when I was 11 and very sick. I saw my mom and dad standing on each side of the tunnel. Both are now deceased, but were alive at the time of this NDE. Again, I was pulled towards the light and felt a warm glowing light surround me. I had no worries. Time seemed to stop and I had no ill feelings of want or need or hurry. It felt amazing and wonderful. I knew I was headed home, as it seemed that way. The next moment I woke up with the drill instructor standing over me. It was rather disappointing when I realized where I was.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Learning how to choke and kill people. We practiced on each other. Other Learning how to kill people. Cutting off blood supply to the brain through choking holds. If held long enough-it will kill you. | Yes Illness Other Extremely High Temperature of 105 F degrees and spiking up to 108. My heart stopped 3 times and my mother had to start my heart 3 times. She was a Nurses Aide at the time.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone | A landscape or city
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it | No I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal
elements.At what time during the experience were: Yes. | When I started to recover, after massive amounts of penicillin. It was three days before I received the shots in the butt. Then it took a couple more days to fully recover. After the second recovery date, I recalled the experience fully. I told my sisters and my mom about it, and they said I had mumbled about snakes, having a job, and just rambled, but I don't recall any of that. The only true experience, to me, was the NDE.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning No time seemed to exist. | Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning There was no time evident, and it didn't seem to matter.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I had heightened senses and clarity of mind. My vision was 20/20 and I could see very clearly those around me. However, the distance of vision was limited. | There seemed to be a mist that was surrounding the area. It didn't really block the immediate view and was only at the edges of where I was with Jesus.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes It was a dark tunnel with a very bright light. | No
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes My deceased parents and my grandma and grandpa. | Yes I met Jesus.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was a light brighter than the sun. It was at the end of the tunnel I was in. | Yes The light was the brightest I had ever seen, both then and now. It was warm and pulled me towards it. It didn't hurt my eyes.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: No | A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Heaven, I just knew that was where I was.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Very strong feelings of peace, tranquility and just a fitting in the whole picture of the universe. I felt completely loved and welcomed by those around me. | I felt Great Love and Joy, and Warmth and Peace. It is difficult to put the strength of those emotions into words. They were extremely strong!
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Deja vu | Scenes from the world's future I seemed to have déjà vu from that point on. It still happens to this day.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes They've gotten stronger. | Yes They grew stronger.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes They've gotten stronger. | Yes They grew stronger.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes Everything in the universe seemed to be in order. | No
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I have become more spiritual since my experience. | No
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I have become more spiritual since my experience. After the NDE | tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: No | Yes There was an experience of disappointment, because Jesus told me I had to go back, and I didn't want to go back. That is difficult to explain to someone.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: No, except I was expecting to see Jesus and did not reach that point. | This experience made me not afraid to die. It helped me in combat and in talking to guys that were about to die.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes About 1 year. | Yes I shared it three days later. They didn't argue and even laughed a bit. I don't know.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes When I was extremely sick at age 11 I had a very similar experience when my heart stopped on a vacation. | No
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I just knew it was real, because the types of holds we were using were already proven to kill people. I was expecting to see Jesus and did not reach that point. | Experience was definitely real I had no doubt in my mind because I didn't recall my ramblings, but I distinctly remembered the experience with Christ.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real My viewpoint has not changed since I was in boot camp. | Experience was definitely real I had no doubt then, and I had one more NDE later when I was 18.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I am not afraid to die, because I know what is waiting for me!
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: You may want to ask people about whether they feel afraid of dying after the NDE. That seems to be a theme in my experiences.
